description: This file defines a database migration that fixes the nullability and default values of the address fields in the 'Orders' table for the 'ShipToAddress' columns.

classes.name: FixShipToAddress
classes.description: A migration class derived from Migration that updates 'ShipToAddress' fields in the 'Orders' table.

methods.name: Up
methods.description: Applies the migration: alters 'ShipToAddress' columns to be non-nullable with default empty string values.

methods.name: Down
methods.description: Reverts the migration: restores 'ShipToAddress' columns to nullable without default values.
